name: Stephanie Acton
title: Accounting
bio: Stephanie Acton has been working as a Project Accountant at The Ritchie Group since 2017. Prior to joining The Ritchie Group, she worked in Commercial Property Management for over 5 years in Park City, Utah. Stephanie received a Bachelor of Science Degree in Accounting & Business Management from the Woodbury School of Business at Utah Valley University. When she isn’t crunching numbers, she can be found riding her mountain bike near Little Dell Reservoir.
